lines.text: Many learners say: Please don't mind.
Use don't worry to say it is fine.

data.why: Use don't worry to say it is fine.

native.tip: 「気にしないで」は Don't worry about it. が自然です。
native.caption: “Please don't mind.”と言っていませんか？😅 「気にしない」の「気にする」を mind で訳しがちです。“Please don't worry.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“worry”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: To comfort someone, say Don't worry.
en.caption: Do you say this? “Please don't mind.” 😅 The Japanese 気にしないで does not match mind in English. The natural way is “Please don't worry.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
